confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context, not from inspected booking pages or current listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable. Hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because accommodation prices vary widely by neighbourhood and season. Drink anchors are estimated from local price levels. Figures assume July 2026 (austral winter, dry season) and a BRL/USD rate near recent levels; BRL moves can shift all USD anchors. FX: the RBA observation could not be verified. Searches returned a reported 0.6955 USD per AUD for 15 October 2026, but a follow-up search could not confirm it, and the only RBA table found was a cached March 2026 copy. fx values are therefore null rather than an unverified figure. Check the RBA F11.1 daily table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against mid-sized and large Latin American capitals with similar tourist-to-local price ratios (for example Mexico City and Buenos Aires), adjusted to São Paulo's local price levels. Accommodation is benchmarked to registered hostels and hotels in comparable Brazilian metropolitan areas.
